knowledge.title: The Narrowing passes on its own
knowledge.description: The deep Narrowing of 2291 is the trough of a slow beat between two natural rhythms. The Needle recovers whether or not anything is fed to it. Every Keeping since has been timed to a recovery already under way.

knowledge.title: The Keeping is an instrument of governance
knowledge.description: Hesper Vane designed the Keeping, and sold it to the Ostrander Board in her Memorandum, as the means by which the Reach would go on sending glass and obeying after the Withdrawal: a sacrifice that makes the one who reads the Needle indispensable.

knowledge.title: The Draw is rigged
knowledge.description: The Wheel is weighted: Shoals names are fed in threefold, and some names are not drawn at all but chosen by the High Warden.

knowledge.title: Mor chose Pell
knowledge.description: High Warden Mor had Pell Asante's name chosen, not drawn, to bend Speaker Efua Asante's vote on the war.

knowledge.title: The oldest harp records were cut
knowledge.description: The Anchorhold archive holds no harp records from before the First Keeping: the eleven years before 2291 are a gap the Wardens call the Blank Year.

knowledge.title: The Hunger Tone is not the Fork's note
knowledge.description: The harp has been tuned since the First Keeping to the Hunger Tone, which is not the pitch of the Founder's Fork. Tuned to the Hunger Tone, the harp cannot hear the Needle recover.

knowledge.title: The throat is choked with glass
knowledge.description: The Needle is not starving. Its waist is crowded with a vast accretion of brine-glass: it is choking.

knowledge.title: The Keeping makes the scar
knowledge.description: Glass released at the waist does not burn away. It accretes, a layer for each Keeping. Sixty Keepings will close the throat.

knowledge.title: The High Wardens inherit the lie
knowledge.description: Each High Warden, at investiture, reads the First Warden's Testament and learns that the Keeping is unnecessary; each keeps it.

knowledge.title: Ambrose was murdered
knowledge.description: Ambrose Lyle did not fall from the Lectern gallery; Brandt's men killed him on Hesper Vane's order.

knowledge.title: Hesper Vane was the First Warden
knowledge.description: The First Warden of the Throat, founder of the Wardens, was Hesper Vane.

knowledge.title: The Founder's Fork was Ambrose's
knowledge.description: The Wardens' relic is Ambrose Lyle's tuning fork. Its engraving reads 'for Clare', his daughter — not 'For Clarity'.

knowledge.title: Teo flew to cross, not to keep
knowledge.description: Teo Kesh never released her glass. She flew the Small Mercy into the Long Night to cross to the Inward with Ambrose's proof.

knowledge.title: The Bell can ring the throat
knowledge.description: Ambrose's old sounding buoy, driven with the harp and tuned to the Fork, can set the throat ringing at its true pitch and shake the accretion loose.

knowledge.title: The oldest Return is the Small Mercy
knowledge.description: Among what the Needle gave back at the Sixtieth Narrowing was Teo Kesh's tug, with Teo in it, and her log.
